articleTitle: The effect of empagliflozin on inflammation and oxidative stress in patients undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention, a randomized controlled trial.
takeaways: Empagliflozin 10mg taken for just 3 days significantly reduced cystatin C levels (a kidney function and cardiovascular risk marker) and pro-oxidant-antioxidant balance in patients undergoing heart procedures

Short-term empagliflozin treatment (3 days) showed statistically significant anti-inflammatory effects on C-reactive protein levels when adjusted for other factors, demonstrating rapid cardioprotective benefits

The study included 121 cardiovascular patients (52.8% male) and found that empagliflozin's anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects can begin working within 3 days, much faster than previously documented long-term benefits

Empagliflozin demonstrated measurable reductions in oxidative stress markers within 72 hours of starting treatment, suggesting the medication provides immediate protective mechanisms during cardiovascular procedures
